title: A number explorer
description:
Read numbers until the input ends and print facts about each one, with a blank line between blocks. For `27` and `12`:

```
n = 27
collatz steps: 111
highest point: 9232
digit sum: 9
divisors: 4
prime: no
bits set: 4

n = 12
collatz steps: 9
highest point: 16
digit sum: 3
divisors: 6
prime: no
bits set: 2
```

| Line | Means |
|---|---|
| `collatz steps` | how many steps of the Collatz rule reach 1: an even number is halved, an odd one becomes 3n + 1 |
| `highest point` | the largest value on the way (n itself counts) |
| `digit sum` | the sum of n's decimal digits |
| `divisors` | how many numbers from 1 to n divide n exactly |
| `prime` | `yes` if n has exactly two divisors, otherwise `no` |
| `bits set` | how many 1 bits n has |

A number below 1 prints `n = ` and the number, then `must be at least 1`, as its block. The numbers are at most 1,000,000.

starter.main.asm:
global  _start
        section .data
s_n:    db      "n = ", 0

        section .text
_start:
.next:
        call    read_int
        test    rdx, rdx
        jz      .exit
        mov     rbx, rax
        lea     rdi, [rel s_n]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline
        jmp     .next
.exit:
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

solution.main.asm:
global  _start
        section .data
s_n:     db     "n = ", 0
s_small: db     "must be at least 1", 10, 0
s_steps: db     "collatz steps: ", 0
s_high:  db     "highest point: ", 0
s_dsum:  db     "digit sum: ", 0
s_divs:  db     "divisors: ", 0
s_prime: db     "prime: ", 0
s_yes:   db     "yes", 10, 0
s_no:    db     "no", 10, 0
s_bits:  db     "bits set: ", 0

        section .text
_start:
        xor     r15d, r15d              ; 1 after the first block, for the blank lines
.next:
        call    read_int
        test    rdx, rdx
        jz      .exit
        mov     rbx, rax                ; n
        test    r15, r15
        jz      .first
        call    print_newline
.first: mov     r15d, 1
        lea     rdi, [rel s_n]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline
        cmp     rbx, 1
        jge     .facts
        lea     rdi, [rel s_small]
        call    print_str
        jmp     .next

.facts:
        ; Collatz: r12 = steps, r13 = highest, rax = the value
        xor     r12d, r12d
        mov     r13, rbx
        mov     rax, rbx
.collatz:
        cmp     rax, 1
        je      .collatz_done
        test    rax, 1
        jnz     .odd
        shr     rax, 1                  ; even: halve
        jmp     .counted
.odd:   lea     rax, [rax + rax*2 + 1]  ; odd: 3n + 1
.counted:
        inc     r12
        cmp     rax, r13
        jbe     .collatz
        mov     r13, rax
        jmp     .collatz
.collatz_done:
        lea     rdi, [rel s_steps]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline
        lea     rdi, [rel s_high]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r13
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        ; digit sum
        mov     rax, rbx
        xor     r12d, r12d
        mov     ecx, 10
.digits:
        xor     edx, edx
        div     rcx
        add     r12, rdx
        test    rax, rax
        jnz     .digits
        lea     rdi, [rel s_dsum]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        ; divisors: r12 = count, rcx = the candidate
        xor     r12d, r12d
        mov     ecx, 1
.divs:  mov     rax, rbx
        xor     edx, edx
        div     rcx
        test    rdx, rdx
        jnz     .not_div
        inc     r12
.not_div:
        inc     rcx
        cmp     rcx, rbx
        jbe     .divs
        lea     rdi, [rel s_divs]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline
        lea     rdi, [rel s_prime]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rel s_no]
        cmp     r12, 2
        jne     .say_prime
        lea     rdi, [rel s_yes]
.say_prime:
        call    print_str

        ; bits set
        mov     rax, rbx
        xor     r12d, r12d
.bits:  test    rax, rax
        jz      .bits_done
        mov     rdx, rax
        and     edx, 1
        add     r12, rdx
        shr     rax, 1
        jmp     .bits
.bits_done:
        lea     rdi, [rel s_bits]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline
        jmp     .next

.exit:
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

requirements: Each fact is its own loop.
Use a shift (not a division) to halve and to test for even numbers.
Keep values that must survive the print routines in rbx and r12 to r15.
